verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents a built-in Email Assistant that you delegate inbox work to. It labels, archives low-priority mail, drafts replies in your voice using inbox, calendar and web context, and reminds you to follow up. Ask AI answers conversational questions with follow-ups, and users can create agents via chat or a visual builder that run proactively on triggers, steered by plain-language instructions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed, and evidence that free-form action-taking (rather than Q&A) is possible from the in-app chat itself, since prompt-driven send and schedule actions are documented mainly through external assistants via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Get an email assistant that automatically labels incoming emails, archives low-priority messages, drafts replies, and reminds you to follow up.
Email Assistant organizes your inbox, drafts replies in your voice, and keeps every follow-up on track, all inside Gmail or Outlook.
Each draft can use your inbox, calendar, and the web to write replies that are ready to send.
You can ask follow-up questions in a conversation.
Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.
Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.
